AgentRole.title: AgentRole

ApprovalRequirement.description: A requirement, never an approval or an authority grant.
ApprovalRequirement.title: ApprovalRequirement

AuthConfigResponse.description: Lets the SPA tell local development (no sign-in) from OIDC (sign-in required).
AuthConfigResponse.title: AuthConfigResponse

ComparisonClaim.description: The magnitudes of two facts' differences, in the same unit, compared exactly.
ComparisonClaim.title: ComparisonClaim

digest.description: Identifies this exact notice and recipient list.
digest.title: Digest

recipients.description: Every external recipient accepting this notice would authorize.
recipients.title: Recipients

accepted.description: Whether an acceptance of a recognized notice is in force.
accepted.title: Accepted

can_manage.description: Whether this caller holds `workspace:admin`, so may accept or withdraw.
can_manage.title: Can Manage

data_recipients.description: The recipients the consent in force really authorizes.
data_recipients.title: Data Recipients

notice.description: The current notice, or null when this server shares data with no recipient.

questions_enabled.description: Whether the consent in force covers every recipient of model-backed questions.
questions_enabled.title: Questions Enabled

required.description: Whether this server would send data to any recipient.
required.title: Required

notice_digest.title: Notice Digest

CostEstimate.description: Always an estimate. ``enforced_upper_bound`` only when the ledger can actually hold it.
CostEstimate.title: CostEstimate

CritiqueFinding.description:
One validated Critic finding: fixed codes and identifiers only (INV-7 decision C1).

``evidence_ids`` are existing evidence of this investigation that support the finding (a
fabricated or foreign reference is never stored; it is the finding). ``claim_index`` points
into the transient draft, which is never stored. Only a confirmed model gap
(``missing_stratification``, origin ``model_confirmed``) carries a stratification.
CritiqueFinding.title: CritiqueFinding

DerivedEvidenceItem.description: A fixed arithmetic operation over this task's own query evidence.
DerivedEvidenceItem.title: DerivedEvidenceItem

DerivedRatio.description: One exact ratio: an event count (or value sum) over a population (or row) count.
DerivedRatio.title: DerivedRatio

DerivedStratum.description: One band's baseline and comparison counts (events over population), as recorded.
DerivedStratum.title: DerivedStratum

DocumentEvidenceItem.description: Document evidence as locations and statuses, never the model-written answer.
DocumentEvidenceItem.title: DocumentEvidenceItem

DocumentSourceItem.description: A retrieved source's location; the passage itself is never stored.
DocumentSourceItem.title: DocumentSourceItem

ExecutionSummaryResponse.description:
Content-free counts describing what the workflow did for one answer.

Every value comes from the diagnostics the orchestrator already records; there is
no per-step trace, timestamp, prompt, or model output behind it.
ExecutionSummaryResponse.title: ExecutionSummaryResponse

FactValue.description: One side of a fact: the counts as recorded and the displayed value (4 decimals).
FactValue.title: FactValue

HypothesisRow.title: HypothesisRow

InvestigationEvidenceResponse.description:
The typed verified report and the evidence behind it, from one digest-checked read.

``evidence_state``: ``available``; ``not_reported`` for a failed run, whose report carries codes
only; ``unavailable`` for a record whose stored digest does not cover its evidence.
InvestigationEvidenceResponse.title: InvestigationEvidenceResponse

InvestigationProposalMessage.description: A read-only recommendation, never an approval or execution handle.
InvestigationProposalMessage.title: InvestigationProposalMessage

InvestigationProposalReviewResponse.description: Display-only proposal details; never approval or execution authority.
InvestigationProposalReviewResponse.title: InvestigationProposalReviewResponse

LimitationCode.description: Fixed, content-free reasons a result is incomplete. Report wording is keyed by code (S5).
LimitationCode.title: LimitationCode

ProvenanceResponse.description:
Content-free description of how an answer was checked.

These are structural checks (citation numbers, verbatim quotes, literal
criteria overlap), not proof that the answer is correct.
ProvenanceResponse.title: ProvenanceResponse

QueryEvidenceItem.description: Query evidence: its first rows (no more than the report shows) and how it was produced.
QueryEvidenceItem.title: QueryEvidenceItem

Recommendation.description: One triggered investigation-method rule (V5), citing what triggered it.
Recommendation.title: Recommendation

ReportCitation.description: A verified citation's location. Never the passage or the model's answer.
ReportCitation.title: ReportCitation

ReportCritiqueRow.description: One critic round as statuses, an outcome, and fixed-code findings. Never a claim.
ReportCritiqueRow.title: ReportCritiqueRow

ReportFact.description:
One verified measurement: an approved test's two sides and their difference.

``difference`` is comparison minus baseline in the metric's unit (4 decimals, signed).
For proportions:
- ``percentage_points`` is that difference × 100 (1 decimal, signed);
- ``relative_change`` is the difference over the baseline × 100, as a percent (1 decimal,
  signed), and is omitted when the baseline is 0.

``direction`` is the observed sign; ``claimed_direction`` and ``outcome`` are the approved
claim and what the verdict rules made of it. A standardized fact names its stratification.
ReportFact.title: ReportFact

ReportQueryTable.description: Verified query cells as recorded, cut to the first ``MAX_REPORT_QUERY_ROWS`` rows.
ReportQueryTable.title: ReportQueryTable

SQLWaveReviewResponse.description: The approver's review of a pending wave, including each statement's SQL.
SQLWaveReviewResponse.title: SQLWaveReviewResponse

SQLWaveSummary.description: A pending wave's identity: what a decision must echo. No SQL.
SQLWaveSummary.title: SQLWaveSummary

SessionResponse.description: What the SPA may know: its CSRF value, roles for UI gating, and when the session ends.
SessionResponse.title: SessionResponse

Stratification.description:
Fixed integer bands over one numeric field (INV-7 decision C4).

``band_0`` holds values below the first cut point, ``band_i`` holds values in
``[cut_{i-1}, cut_i)``, and the last band holds values at or above the last cut point. Labels
are fixed, so neither a model nor a reader ever names a band.
Stratification.title: Stratification

VerifiedReport.title: VerifiedReport

WorkspaceOverviewResponse.description:
Identifiers that let a client rebuild its view of one workspace after a reload.

Every identifier is the newest resource of its kind inside the workspace and is
resolved through the same tenant-scoped lookups as the resource's own endpoint.
WorkspaceOverviewResponse.title: WorkspaceOverviewResponse

retention_hours.description: Hours of inactivity after which the workspace and all its data are deleted. Any use of the workspace extends `expires_at` by this amount.
retention_hours.title: Retention Hours

info.summary: Versioned local API for conversational business intelligence workflows.
info.title: Conversational BI API

post.description:
This synchronous create operation does not support `Idempotency-Key`. A duplicate request may create
another resource or repeat work and is not replayed; idempotency-key conflicts therefore do not
apply. The created resource follows its owning workspace's retention. It survives a process restart
when the deployment enables durable metadata (the Compose topology does) and is otherwise lost on
process restart. A client timeout or disconnect does not cancel server work, and the request must
not be retried automatically. Resolve the original outcome through its owning resource or ask the
user before submitting again. State/precondition conflicts return `409` and are not transient.

get.description:
Streams the complete immutable representation in bounded chunks. `Content-Length` and attachment
`Content-Disposition` are always present. Byte ranges are not supported (`Accept-Ranges: none`), so
a partial transfer must be restarted with a new `GET`. A timeout or disconnect stops only that
transfer; it does not delete the resource or cancel report generation. The `GET` is safe to retry.

Accept-Ranges.description: Always `none`; partial byte ranges are not supported.

get.description: Lists the caller's own active workspaces, newest first, so a reloaded client can rediscover its work. Other tenants' workspaces are never listed, and listing does not extend retention.

post.description:
Creates a workspace. `Idempotency-Key` is optional and scoped to the authenticated tenant.
The same key replays the original workspace and returns `201`; because this operation has no client
representation, a same-key payload conflict cannot occur. The mapping is retained until the
workspace expires or is deleted. It survives a process restart when the deployment enables durable
metadata (the Compose topology does) and is otherwise lost on process restart. After a client
timeout, retry is safe only with the same key. Without a key, retry may create another workspace.

delete.description: Withdraws the workspace's consent for every recipient. Idempotent. No new model request starts after a check that observes it; a request already sent is not recalled.

get.description: The workspace's consent status and the current server-owned notice, including every external recipient accepting it would authorize. Accepting a notice activates nothing.

Another tenant's workspace returns `404`. An oversized workspace returns `413`. Streams the complete immutable representation in bounded chunks. `Content-Length` and attachment

a partial transfer must be restarted with a new `GET`. A timeout or disconnect stops only that
transfer; it does not delete the resource or cancel report generation. The `GET` is safe to retry.

200.description: ZIP archive of the workspace's own data

Accept-Ranges.description: Always `none`; partial byte ranges are not supported.
